# `assets/weapon/WeaponTimeline.js`

> **Source:** `engine/assets/weapon/WeaponTimeline.js`

engine/assets/weapon/WeaponTimeline.js — keyframed event tracks for weapon actions (fire, reload). An action is an ordered list of { t, type, payload } events over a duration; `eventsBetween` returns events crossed in a time step so the host fires them exactly once (deterministic, frame-rate independent). GAME ABSTRACTION — timings are gameplay anchors, not real mechanisms.

## Functions

### `createWeaponAction(init = {})`

Create a single action timeline (e.g. one shot, or a reload).

**Parameters:**

- `init` *(object)* — { name, duration, events:[{t,type,payload?}] }

### `defaultFireAction(duration = 0.12)`

A default semi-auto fire action (normalized 0..duration seconds).

### `defaultReloadAction(duration = 2.0)`

A default reload action.

### `eventsBetween(action, t0, t1)`

Events whose time t lies in (t0, t1]. Use with an advancing playhead so each event fires exactly once regardless of frame rate.

### `createTimelinePlayer(action)`

A small play-once cursor over an action.

## Constants

- `WEAPON_EVENT`
